claim_boundary: WTI is an observable global growth, inflation and supply-shock price, not a direct Bitcoin-liquidity measure or established Bitcoin predictor. A positive four-week WTI direction may coincide with broad risk appetite and reflation, but oil-specific supply shocks can reverse that sign. This weak but causally distinct prior supports one audit only.

primary_sources.title: Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) - Cushing, Oklahoma
primary_sources.publisher: U.S. Energy Information Administration via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
primary_sources.use: Official weekly Friday-ending WTI spot-price identity, units, frequency and free present-vintage CSV source.

primary_sources.title: Spot Prices for Crude Oil and Petroleum Products
primary_sources.use: Official source and weekly aggregation boundary; EIA calculates weekly prices as unweighted averages of daily closing spot prices.

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_broad_dollar_and_re: WTI is a physical commodity spot-price direction, not the broad dollar, a Treasury yield, breakeven inflation or a financial-conditions index.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_btc_native_price_fa: The decision reads only lagged WTI weekly prices and cannot use BTC momentum, volatility, volume, drawdown, valuation or on-chain state.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.prohibited_rescue: Do not add Brent, natural gas, futures curves, inventories, equities, inflation data, BTC interactions, thresholds, smoothing, alternate horizons, direction inversion, fractional sizing or leverage after access.

adversarial_prior: WTI can rise because of adverse supply shocks while risk assets fall.
WTI can turn negative or behave discontinuously during storage and contract-market stress, so level continuity is not guaranteed.
The weekly series is present-vintage and can be revised; it is not an original-release-vintage archive.
Commodity and Bitcoin co-movement may be unstable across inflation, growth and crisis regimes.
A long-cash rule can appear safer only because it forfeits most BTC upside.
